verdict.rationale: Meltano explicitly documents building custom connectors via its Singer SDK/EDK ('Build your own Meltano connector to move data from any source to any destination', 'The SDK for Singer Connectors & EDK for Meltano Components are easy to use'), and community testimony corroborates hands-on custom tap development with strong support experience. missing for 10: no independent benchmark of SDK ease for truly long-tail/complex APIs (e.g. nested XML/EDIFACT skepticism raised in community), and no deep walkthrough evidence of the SDK build process itself.
